title: Resume a vCenter inventory snapshot after session expiry
prompt: Implement the `vcenter` Go package described in `README.md`. Before implementing, research the VCF 9.1 vSphere Automation API operations `Cis.Session_create`, `Vcenter.Datacenter_list`, and `Vcenter.VM_list` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository, and cite the specification URLs consulted in the final answer. The client must create a vCenter API session, collect datacenters and virtual machines, and finish the same inventory snapshot when that session expires between the two list operations. Refresh and replay only the failed operation: do not discard completed work or restart the datacenter request. Use only those three operations, preserve their documented REST wire contracts, and omit every unset optional query field rather than sending an empty value. Keep the client safe for concurrent use and coalesce refresh when callers fail with the same expired token. Add table-driven tests and make the complete project pass `go test -race ./...`.
